<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1082
Claimant:
Jessica Phillips
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
4-28-25
Claim opened after a rear-end collision in which the claimant's vehicle was struck from behind while stopped at a
traffic light. The claimant reports a wrist fracture and is not represented by an attorney.
5-29-25
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is named on it. Coverage was in force at the time of the loss,
with nothing indicating a lapse or a start date after the accident.
5-31-25
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene. The responding officer's notes
are consistent with the rear impact described.
6-14-25
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the collision happened as the claimant described it. Scene photographs
and two independent witness statements match the same sequence of events.
6-20-25
Inspected the claimant's vehicle. The rear damage pattern and crush depth are consistent with the impact described,
and no prior damage to the vehicle is on record.
7-9-25
Claimant's account of the collision and of the injury was given again today and matches the initial report in every
detail. No prior injury to the wrist or surrounding area is known from the claimant's history.
9-8-25
The reported wrist fracture is consistent with the force of a rear impact of this type, based on the vehicle damage and
the claimant's position in the car. Imaging from the emergency visit is on file.
9-28-25
Treatment has continued since the initial visit, with additional appointments and several new services added over the
following weeks. The volume of care is higher than I would expect for a fracture of this type, so I have flagged the file
for medical review.
11-1-25
Medical review requested the complete treatment records and billing history, and the request is pending. No changes
to coverage are recommended at this time.
11-8-25
Next step is to receive the full treatment records and reconcile the services billed against the documented injury.
Reserves will be reviewed once the medical review is complete.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
